description: This file defines an interface for office-related write operations within the Fineract platform, including creating, updating, and deleting office data, as well as handling transactions.

classes.name: OfficeWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for office write operations such as create, update, and delete, in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createOffice
methods.description: Creates a new office entity based on the provided command.

methods.name: updateOffice
methods.description: Updates an existing office identified by officeId with data from the command.

methods.name: officeTransaction
methods.description: Handles a transaction related to an office, as specified by the command.

methods.name: deleteOfficeTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a specific office transaction identified by id, based on the provided command.
